name: MiMo-V2.6-Flash
archDisplay: Sparse MoE, 309B total / 15B active; 48 layers (39 SWA / 9 GA), hidden 4096, 256 routed experts with 8 active, no shared experts; 681M MiMo ViT + 308M AudioTokenizer + 127M audio patch encoder; 5-layer MTP predicting 7 tokens
note: The smaller open-weights (MIT) model of Xiaomi's 2026-09-22 MiMo-V2.6 launch: a 309B / 15B-active omnimodal MoE with 1M context, the same size class as MiMo-V2.5, priced unchanged at $0.14/$0.28 per Mtok. On Xiaomi's table it lands within a few points of V2.6-Pro on most agentic rows (Terminal Bench 2.1 87.6 vs 89.9, OSWorld-Verified 80.8 vs 82.0) and slightly above it on CyberGym (95.1), but far below on ExploitBench (25.3 vs 47.9) and SEC Bench Pro.
